'''''Cu'bikad''''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] indoor game that could be played by up to at least four players,<ref name="Sacrifice" /> and involved stabbing short-handled blades into a checkered board.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

Considered a somewhat rough game, there were some who believed that ''cu'bikad'' should not be played by non-Mandalorians.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

The ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]] in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], had at least one ''cu'bikad'' board for its patrons to play on. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the Mandalorians [[Baltan Carid]], [[Mirta Gev]], [[Dinua Jeban]], and [[Medrit Vasur]] played a game of ''cu'bikad'' together at the ''Oyu'baat''.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Behind the scenes==
The game of ''cu'bikad'' was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel [[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice|''Sacrifice'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[May 29]], [[2007]]. The table game was initially unnamed,<ref name="Sacrifice" /> and remained so until Traviss' subsequent entry into the ''Legacy of the Force'' series, [[Legacy of the Force: Revelation|''Revelation'']], published the following year on [[February 26]], [[2008]].<ref name="Revelation" />
